dataset.name: Primary colon cancer cohort (Sidra-LUMC AC-ICAM, 2023)
dataset.description: Independent primary colon cancer cohort with bulk RNA-seq and linked overall, disease-specific and progression-free survival.
dataset.cohort_context: Fresh-frozen, treatment-naive primary colon cancers retained after cross-platform quality control; one tumor and one patient record are supplied for each participant.

metadata.study_design: Retrospective primary colon cancer cohort with prospectively prespecified immune-signature validation
metadata.curation_note: The cBioPortal study metadata reports zero RNA-seq samples because its RNA sample-list category is absent, but the immutable expression file contains 348 primary tumors that map one-to-one to 348 clinical records.

expression.label: log2 EDASeq/quantile-normalized counts
expression.source_unit: EDASeq within/between-lane and quantile-normalized gene counts
expression.duplicate_feature_rationale: Repeated rows with the same supplied symbol are averaged sample-wise before log2(normalized count + 1); different identifiers are never merged implicitly.
expression.scale_note: The source publication describes featureCounts followed by EDASeq within- and between-lane normalization and preprocessCore quantile normalization. TRACE Explorer applies the publication's downstream log2(x + 1) transformation to the supplied normalized matrix.

endpoints.label: Disease-specific survival
endpoints.event_definition: Colon-cancer death as encoded by the source DSS status

endpoints.label: Progression-free survival
endpoints.event_definition: Progression, recurrence or death as encoded by the source PFS status
